description: Prototype rules for PackShift redesign. Clearances are planning assumptions, not a certified protective-packaging standard.
joint_allowance_note: The manufacturer's joint is a fixed 35 mm prototype allowance. It is not a plant-specific glue-flap specification.
manufacturing_waste_note: Unit cost uses the rectangular blank. No extra scrap percentage is applied. Slot notches are cut from inside that rectangle and do not enlarge it.
external_dimension_policy: Internal size is the external size minus twice the board thickness on every axis. Thickness comes from current_packaging.board_thickness_mm when it is sent, otherwise from the catalogue thickness of current_packaging.material_id. The request is rejected when neither value exists.
orientation_policy: The declared length, width and height are kept when that pose is allowed. Other permitted poses are reported and are not selected only to reduce package volume.
